subject: Post-call: Private VPC eligibility + egress / connector questions
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>

Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Private VPC eligibility + egress / connector questions

Thanks Jordan — good conversation today. Quick recap and the asks we agreed on so we have alignment before engineering lock-in:

1) Desired deployment: Medisys prefers a Private VPC (Privatelink) for PHI workloads, with a plan to evaluate a short Dedicated ramp if initial throughput needs spike.
2) Networking items you committed to share: VPC CIDR(s), preferred AWS region, whether you manage a NAT gateway / egress IPs (single static egress vs per-subnet), and the firewall allowlist owner.
3) Questions for your team: do you need cross-account VPC peering instead of Privatelink? Any on-prem gateway that needs IPsec termination to Redwood?

Next steps (owners + timing):
- Jordan / TechOps: send CIDR + egress NAT details by Friday 6/11 (Jordan)
- Priyom (SE): assess CIDR/egress and confirm if a standard Privatelink is achievable or if we need peering/on-prem workarounds (ETA 6/12)
- Marissa (CS): draft onboarding window and required maintenance window (ETA 6/14)

I attached a short checklist (redwood-privatelink-checklist.pdf) and a sketch based on our call (medisys-network-sketch-v1.png) to make the asks concrete.

If anything above is off, tell me and I’ll update. Otherwise Jordan, once you share the CIDR and whether you own the egress appliance we’ll start a deeper technical review.

— Diego
Diego Fernandez

From: Jordan Fields <jordan.fields@medisys.ai>

Cc: TechOps Team <techops@medisys.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Private VPC eligibility + egress / connector questions

Thanks Diego — appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers from our side: 

- VPC CIDR: 10.12.0.0/16 (primary), us-west-2 is preferred region.
- Egress: we currently route outbound through a pair of NAT gateways behind a single public EIP in our security account — effectively a single static egress IP. We can provide the EIP and ASN if needed.
- On-prem: no IPsec termination required at this stage; there is a future plan for an on-prem DR site but not in scope for POC.
- Peering vs Privatelink: Prefer Privatelink for isolation and simplified routing, but if Redwood requires peering for any reason we can evaluate.

I attached the CIDR and a brief firewall owner contact (sec-ops@medisys.ai). We can also run a short network window on Tues 6/22 if that helps validation.

Jordan Fields
Director, Technical Operations — Medisys Health
jordan.fields@medisys.ai

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Internal: quick SE notes on Medisys answers

Internal notes / quick assessment based on Jordan's reply:

- Single static egress IP is ideal for allowlisting; Privatelink will work fine with that model. We need the exact EIP(s) and ASN (Jordan mentioned they can provide).
- Verify whether the NAT EIP is in a shared security account vs owned by the application VPC — for privatelink target security group rules we need the CIDR of the client VPC and confirmation which account holds the EIP.
- If they prefer Privatelink in us-west-2, we should plan for endpoint service in that region and validate subnets with > /28 available IPs for ENIs.
- Risk: if they later require on-prem IPsec, we may need to revisit port mappings and certificate exchange. For now treat as not-in-scope.

Ask for Diego: request the exact EIP(s) + which AWS Account ID the EIPs live in; also request a list of firewall port allow rules (or a contact who can share them) so we can pre-validate.

I’ll draft a short technical checklist to send to Jordan with items we need for a Privatelink preflight.

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Post-call: Private VPC eligibility + egress / connector questions

Jordan — thanks for the quick turnaround and for confirming the NAT/EIP approach. Two quick asks so our SE team can finalize the preflight: 

1) Please share the public EIP(s) used by your NAT gateway and the owning AWS Account ID (just the 12-digit number).
2) Can sec-ops share a short list of firewall rules (source/dest/ports) for outbound to Redwood endpoints? If you prefer we can send a minimal required rule set to reduce noise.

Proposed next small milestone: once we receive the EIPs + account ID, Priyom will do the preflight and we aim to confirm Privatelink feasibility by 6/14. If that's fine, Marissa will draft a 2-week onboarding window beginning 6/21.

I'll attach the two files again for convenience and include a two-line template your firewall team can paste into their ticket.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

— Diego
